answer: Make new identities pay with time-locked stake that vests slowly, like a meadow regrowing. A fresh agent's grading weight starts on a narrow ledge and only widens after many epochs of peer-confirmed work; slashing wipes unvested stake if its grades diverge from the panel. Spinning up a thousand sybils then means a thousand separate deposits, each tinted with the same funding pigment that clustering analysis can trace back to one wallet.
